description: A bashful slate-gray donkey with two very long upright ears, shaggy charcoal forelock, cream muzzle and belly, FOUR sturdy short legs with dark hooves, thin tail ending in a black tuft.
prompt:
Create an original cute PIXEL ART farm game character atlas. The reference establishes only warm pixel colors, chunky readable shapes, dark pixel outlines and appealing cute faces. Do NOT copy its dog anatomy. CHARACTER: A bashful slate-gray donkey with two very long upright ears, shaggy charcoal forelock, cream muzzle and belly, FOUR sturdy short legs with dark hooves, thin tail ending in a black tuft.
EXACTLY EIGHT ROWS by EIGHT COLUMNS, 64 whole characters, equal cells and broad transparent gutters. Every character fits in the middle 60% of its cell. True transparent background, no ground or shadows, no text. ALL ears, tails and feet fully inside their cell.
EIGHT distinct viewing directions, one row each: 1 SOUTH/front; 2 SOUTHWEST/front-left diagonal with head toward BOTTOM-LEFT and rump TOP-RIGHT; 3 WEST/left profile; 4 NORTHWEST/rear-left diagonal with head toward TOP-LEFT and rump BOTTOM-RIGHT, one side flank visible (NOT straight back); 5 NORTH/straight back; 6 NORTHEAST/rear-right diagonal with head TOP-RIGHT and rump BOTTOM-LEFT, a visible side flank (NOT side profile); 7 EAST/right profile; 8 SOUTHEAST/front-right diagonal head BOTTOM-RIGHT and rump TOP-LEFT.
Fixed slightly elevated orthographic camera, same body size, palette, markings and limb count across all64. Every row is a seamless eight-phase cycle: CONTACT A, DOWN A, PASSING A, UP A, opposite CONTACT B, DOWN B, PASSING B, UP B. Columns 1 and 5 must exchange left/right leg positions. Supporting foot sweeps backward while the lifted foot bends and returns forward. Fixed torso center, grounded baseline, stable head. All physical limbs accounted for, no morphing, limping, dragging or sliding, no repeated endpoint.
SPECIES GAIT: FOUR-legged gentle walk, FOUR anatomically distinct legs with clear hooves. Near hind, near fore, far hind, far fore land in four evenly spaced beats. Knees and hocks bend naturally; opposite fore/hind limbs counterbalance. Short cute legs but all FOUR present, never merge them into a tripod. Clearly show every limb's support and swing phases across the cycle, balanced symmetrical strides. No furry dog muzzle on hoofed animals. Horse, donkey and goat have correct hooves; lamb has a peach sheep face without a dog nose. All ears remain paired and the same size throughout the cycle. Calm friendly expression. Approximately64pixel detail, no smooth vector art, no realistic textures, no labels, no cast shadows.
